<script>
        function showConnectionsSection(e) {
            e.preventDefault();

            // 1. Make sure the dashboard tab is active
            var dashboardLink = document.querySelector('.sidebar-menu a[href="#dashboardTab"], .sidebar-menu a[data-bs-target="#dashboardTab"]');
            if (!dashboardLink) {
                // Fallback: find the tab pane directly and activate it
                var dashboardPane = document.getElementById('dashboardTab');
                if (dashboardPane && typeof bootstrap !== 'undefined') {
                    var bsTab = bootstrap.Tab.getOrCreateInstance(
                        document.querySelector('[data-bs-target="#dashboardTab"]') ||
                        document.querySelector('[href="#dashboardTab"]')
                    );
                    if (bsTab) bsTab.show();
                }
                if (dashboardPane) {
                    dashboardPane.classList.add('show', 'active');
                    // Hide other panes
                    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content > .tab-pane').forEach(function(p) {
                        if (p !== dashboardPane) { p.classList.remove('show', 'active'); }
                    });
                }
            } else {
                dashboardLink.click();
            }

            // 2. Reveal the connections section
            var section = document.getElementById('connectionsSection');
            if (section) {
                section.classList.remove('d-none');
            }

            // 3. Mark sidebar link active
            document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-menu .nav-link').forEach(function(l) { l.classList.remove('active'); });
            document.getElementById('sidebarConnectionsLink').classList.add('active');

            // 4. Smooth scroll to it (slight delay so the DOM paints first)
            setTimeout(function() {
                if (section) {
                    section.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }, 100);
        }
    </script>
